name: Ray-Guided Grid Leaping
definition: A volume rendering technique that couples the rendering process with the identification of which sub-volumes ('bricks') must be loaded, using ray-sampling characteristics to determine future data requirements in concert with standard ray traversal and accumulation.
summary: Ray-Guided Grid Leaping is an out-of-core volume rendering technique that breaks GPU memory limits by coupling ray traversal with brick loading, performing lookups once per brick rather than per sample.
